messages:
maria (Support): Customer from Acme Pte reported free trial credits missing after signup. They verified email, region ap-southeast-1, no payment method on file. Need escalation.

sam (SRE): Can you share org id and the user's email? Any screenshots?

maria (Support): Org id: org_01G7abcde. user email: david@acme.sg. Screenshot attached (see link). Billing backend shows 'trial_pending'.

billing-bot: Automated check — org: org_01G7abcde; trial_status: awaiting_payment_method; region: ap-southeast-1; promo_applied: false

josh (Billing): It looks like the trial grant job is gated by payment method for some APAC regions. I will open BL-328 and manually apply credits. Granting 3,000 trial tokens now.

josh (Billing): Done — 3000 credits applied to org_01G7abcde. Customer should see them in dashboard. Leaving a note to investigate region gating logic.

sam (SRE): Repro steps to debug: 1) signup on ap-southeast-1 without PM 2) call GET /v1/billing/orgs/org_01G7abcde -> returns {"trial_status":"awaiting_payment_method"} 3) check worker logs: "grantTrial: skipped - region_not_whitelisted"

sam (SRE): Log snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:03Z grantTrial org=org_01G7abcde region=ap-southeast-1 result=skipped reason=region_not_whitelisted
```

maria (Support): Customer confirmed credits visible, POC unblocked. I'll follow up once BL-328 has a root cause.

josh (Billing): Follow-up action: change billing service to treat region 'ap-southeast-1' as whitelisted for trials; also add test case. Ticket BL-328 assigned to @josh and @sam.

maria (Support): Thanks! :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Ticket BL-328 created — link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BL-328
